description: This source file implements a PostgreSQL-backed vector store with functions to set, get, delete, search, and manage vector data, including persistence and vector similarity search within a storage package for the application.

classes.name: postgresVectorStore
classes.description: Represents a PostgreSQL vector store supporting CRUD and search operations for vector data.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Stores or updates a vector record in the database.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a vector record from the database based on scope, scopeID, and key.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific vector record identified by scope, scopeID, and key.

methods.name: DeleteByPrefix
methods.description: Deletes all vector records with a key that matches the specified prefix within the scope and scopeID.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Performs a vector similarity search within the database with optional filters and returns top K results.
